testcase.name: permanent delete additionally requires the irreversible acknowledgement
a plan containing one protected item is rejected wholesale
an empty plan is never executable
unselectable and zero-byte candidates are never selectable
media always needs the OS dialog while SAF only needs it for permanent delete
a plan cannot run before the customer confirms it
trash runs after confirmation without an irreversible warning
ANY age retains unknown-date files including negative dates
restore requires confirmed media only and never an irreversible warning
trash requires a nonempty selection consisting entirely of media
plan totals use Long and do not overflow on large libraries
only measured and verified statuses count as real data
specific age filters reject unknown dates but retain genuinely old files
